}}

|{{SkinGallery

Has two neon green eyes and a neon green core in its torso.
}}

|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:FallenGiantSkeleton.png|200px]]
|Made entirely of black parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid.

Grey chestplate and shoulder-pads, brown scarf and hood.

Does not have a full torso, but instead has a partial ribcage.

Has two large blue eyeholes.
}}
|Duck
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:DuckGiantSkeleton.png|200px]]
|Large white duck, with two orange feet, an orange beak and black eyes.

Wears a grey helmet with black an yellow goggles, grey vest and wing-pads.
}}

|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:CreepySantaGiantSkeleton.png|200px]]
|White snowman with snow arms, green stone eyes and yellow buttons, carrot nose, black stone teeth and a red Santa hat.

Carries a lantern with its right arm.
}}
